en: Color postcard with a romantic illustration of a young couple kissing in a wooded setting; a hen and an egg appear in the foreground. Caption in Swedish at the bottom reads "En puss i påsk." The reverse shows a multilingual 'Postkarte — Carte postale' layout with a green Swedish 5 öre stamp, Gothenburg museum archive stamp, and a handwritten address to Soffia Thorn on 4th Long Street.
